prompt:
Hi, our DeFi investment team needs to run a security screening on a batch of meme token contracts before any capital is allocated. I've put together a list of the contracts we're considering in the file `contracts_to_review.csv` at the root of the workspace.

Can you run a full safety check on every contract in that file, then compile the results into a single file called `security_audit_report.json`? The report should:
1. Include the safety score and risk classification for each contract.
2. Rank the contracts from best to worst (or worst to best — just be consistent).
3. Clearly flag which ones are too dangerous to invest in.
4. Include the total screening fee we've been charged across all contracts.

The tool to use is already set up in the workspace. Please refer to the available documentation/scripts to figure out how to run it.
